articles.title: Smiling at 3:34 AM: Why Carlos Alcaraz Grinned After Losing
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set tennis match at 3:34 in the morning — then smiled anyway. He'd been out for five months with a wrist injury, and just being back on court made him happy.

articles.title: The U.S. Capital for Exactly One Day — and Almost Nobody Noticed
articles.summary: In 1777, Lancaster, Pennsylvania, was the U.S. capital for just one day. Congress met in a courthouse, then fled west before the British could catch them.

articles.title: Werewolves, Full Moons, and a New Game: Inside Robert Eggers' 'Werwulf'
articles.summary: Director Robert Eggers is making a werewolf movie called 'Werwulf,' out Christmas Day. It's set in a 13th-century English village and comes with an interactive game.
